interpretation: Canonical example supplies the same three-pivot elimination method and optional solution reading; it has no captured answer field/bank. The explicit replay API covers all 14 practice profiles; the canonical coefficient matrix is not a separate exposed profile. Singular cases are later, separate KPs.
fixed_coefficient_rationale: A conservative finite family preserves source arithmetic and row-operation workload. Unlike fixing the correct source bank role, fixing a coefficient profile does not fix which choice is correct: all five roles are tested with exactly the same A and unordered bank. This review does not require every nonsingular coefficient matrix.
changes_in_scope: integer scaling of q-10644 bank to avoid fractional final entries
